outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcome related to preeclampsia with severe features (PEC-S)
cohort: 193 women with PEC-S at or after 34 weeks gestation
finding: Prolonged labor and cesarean delivery during labor were both associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal outcomes related to PEC-S.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery during labor was associated with a higher risk of adverse maternal outcomes related to PEC-S.
